headline: No conference side beats Grand Canyon
dek: All five of Grand Canyon's defeats have come against programmes from outside the conference. Inside it, only UNLV and UC Davis have taken so much as a point off them, each with a draw.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring and standing run together: every programme sits in the conference table exactly where its goals across all its matches put it on this chart.

wire.line: Grand Canyon are the last side in the conference with a match still to play.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Both matches past their date with no published result are UC Davis home matches from August, against California and Chico State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Maxim Scordo has scored twelve of UNLV's 30 goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: All nineteen goals UNLV have conceded went in past Hugo Lemos.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UC Davis have conceded 45 goals, more than Grand Canyon and UNLV together.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seventeen different players have scored for Grand Canyon.

last_match.line: Grand Canyon have not lost since the middle of September.

next_match.line: Grand Canyon's only away defeat came in their first match of the season, at Stanford.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
